segments.sn36.23:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn36.23:1.2: “katamā nu kho, bhante, vedanā, katamo vedanāsamudayo, katamā vedanāsamudayagāminī paṭipadā?
segments.sn36.23:1.4: Ko vedanāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇan”ti?
segments.sn36.23:2.1: “Tisso imā, bhikkhu, vedanā – sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
segments.sn36.23:2.7: Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi … pe … sammāsamādhi.
segments.sn36.23:2.9: Yaṃ vedanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ vedanāya assādo;
segments.sn36.23:2.10: yā vedanā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā, ayaṃ vedanāya ādīnavo;
segments.sn36.23:2.11: yo vedanāya chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ vedanāya nissaraṇan”ti.
